title: Numerical evaluation and role of the symbolic $H_3(q)$ Gram matrix
html:
Numerical evaluation at the substrate

Sympy-computed symbolic entries match the q_0 \approx 1.110 empirical values to a maximum absolute difference \approx 2.1 \times 10^{-16}. At the canonical weight z = q^3/(q^2+1) and the proton-pinned q_0 the determinant is 0, as item 3 of the proposition proves for every q, and the spectrum is \{-0.7527,\ 0,\ 0.7527^{(3)},\ 4.2303\}. The negative eigenvalue shows that Frobenius positivity applies a non-trivial constraint. (Until 2026-10-10 this paragraph quoted \det \approx -0.189 and \lambda \approx -0.855, the excised convention-C values.)

Role in the framework

This proposition replaces the earlier empirical Gram matrix with categorical closed-form entries. Downstream consumers can now rely on proven structural properties. The determinant is settled symbolically: it vanishes at the canonical weight, with radical spanned by the three-strand q-antisymmetriser.
